Website-preset PAD calibration

Selected: partner PAD +0.125

61.7% student / 38.3% partner speaking share, with 18.4% both-silent time. The zero-bias baseline was 50.9% student share and 16.1% both-silent time.

The student remains naturally sampled. The partner retains the training website preset: factorised text, relative lexical min-p 0.1, frequency penalty 0.3 over 50 tokens, adaptive PAD, and audio top-k 50/100. Only an additional fixed PAD logit bias is applied.

Second seed cohort —24 conversations

80 unique two-minute conversations in total. Every audio is student-left, partner-right, at the levels the participants heard. Pose was generated in every trial.

Measurement

Silero 6.2.1 waveform VAD is the primary speech detector, with WebRTC modes1–3 as a cross-check. Speaking share divides student speaking time by both participants' speaking time; overlap counts for both. Both-silent time means neither waveform is detected as speech. Recorded prefill and its 163 ms delivery interval are excluded.

All reported comparisons use the original student export 211 and the general Audio Duplex export 253. Earlier natural-partner trials are superseded and excluded from this decision.
